activity.notes: The 1867 Compromise reorganized the Habsburg lands into Austria-Hungary but did not end Franz Joseph's Austrian imperial title. ATLAS anchors the post-Compromise Austrian imperial crown to the map-level Austria-Hungary polity rather than incorrectly extending the pre-1867 Austrian Empire polity unchanged. His distinct Hungarian kingship is modeled separately.

sources.title: Franz Joseph I — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal identifies Franz Joseph as Emperor of Austria and King of Hungary, with an overall reign from 1848 to 1916 and the constitutional reorganization of 1867.

sources.title: The Austro-Hungarian Dual Monarchy: the coronation of the Hungarian royal couple — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal explains that the 1867 Compromise created the Dual Monarchy and records Franz Joseph's coronation as King of Hungary in Budapest in 1867 while he remained Emperor of Austria.
